voice.name: Cillian
voice.delivery: clear, measured enterprise product guide, neutral accent, confident and concise

blocks.vo_line: EMOS starts in the Command Center, where the full fifteen-stage lifecycle gives every modernization team one shared, governed view of progress.
Bring a portfolio through bounded CSV or JSON intake. EMOS validates structure, previews mappings, and keeps every permitted record owner-scoped.
Enterprise DNA joins business criticality, technology, dependencies, economics, risk, and evidence quality, so missing facts remain visible rather than assumed.
Assessment calculates readiness, complexity, risk, feasibility, and cost baselines deterministically. AI explains the evidence; it never changes the arithmetic.
Teams compare Retain, Retire, Rehost, Replatform, Refactor, and Repurchase, then ask focused follow-ups and reopen the saved assessment history.
A named human decision records approval, rejection, or more evidence required, alongside the rationale, exceptions, and bounded governance audit trail.
Prioritization makes trade-offs transparent across value, effort, risk, dependencies, and strategic alignment. Wave planning turns that sequence into a practical roadmap.
Mobilize assigns accountable owners, closes readiness gaps, and confirms the delivery charter before work moves toward implementation.
Define Target State records architecture, security, data migration, cutover, rollback expectations, and the accountable owner for the delivery baseline.
EMOS currently supports the journey through Define Target State. Execute through Reassess remain visibly Planned, creating an honest, governed path forward.
